frozen_policy_bindings.future_endpoint_rule: A future protocol endpoint may be planned beyond actual_cut_at; unobserved future rows/results remain unavailable.
frozen_policy_bindings.primary_cut_rule: Every retained primary sample clock and concrete cohort observation end is at or before actual_cut_at; protocol endpoint planning is the explicit future exception.

repairs.change: ResearchPeriodPolicyV1.from_config now compares older_data_optional_uses to the exact two frozen literal declarations, while retaining the byte-level config hash. Policy, scope, hash, date, boolean, and scalar fields receive exact type checks.
repairs.public_failure: A changed optional-use label raises ContractError before a primary policy can be constructed.

repairs.change: Named primary wrappers validate ResearchScopeV1 before reading is_primary, require typed ResearchPeriodPolicyV1 and PrimaryAdmissionV1, and raise ContractError for malformed scope/admission objects. Consumer paths also validate admission shape before reading actual_cut_at, closing malformed-object AttributeError bypasses.
repairs.public_failure: Primary scope plus admission=None reaches the period check and then fails closed at the consumer admission boundary; a complete in-period population cannot be promoted without its immutable envelope.

repairs.change: Primary consumers now validate admission identity and actual cut before use, revalidate complete populations through recompilation, reject concrete sample clocks/dependencies after actual_cut_at, reject cohort observation_end after its frozen cut, and preserve source-quality gates as separate failures. Cohort primary journal entries retain research_scope and primary_admission instead of dropping the binding.
repairs.public_failure: A too-early primary admission cut raises post_cut_training_or_dependency for fold/model paths; a changed cohort admission hash or cut raises an integrity failure before journal mutation.

repairs.change: EvaluationRegistry persists research_scope, primary_admission, and actual_cut_at in explicit bindings. Register, begin, and finish compare the complete binding; omission, diagnostic downgrade, changed policy, changed population hash, and changed cut fail before append. Reopened journals restore the same binding. Legacy omitted-scope register/begin/finish continues to use an empty binding.
repairs.public_failure: A primary finish with omitted scope/admission cannot silently append a legacy diagnostic result; a changed finish attempt leaves the append-only journal unchanged.

strict_protocol_state_contract.primary_binding: scope.purpose_scope=primary_model; scope.policy_hash equals the loaded policy hash; admission.scope equals scope; admission.population_hash equals Protocol.sample_manifest_hash; actual_cut_at equals admission.actual_cut_at.
strict_protocol_state_contract.begin_rule: Supplied binding must equal the registered binding exactly. Omitted scope/admission is accepted only when registration was legacy omitted-scope.
strict_protocol_state_contract.finish_rule: Supplied binding must equal both registered and evaluation_started bindings exactly before result append. Primary finish cannot downgrade to legacy by omission.
strict_protocol_state_contract.reopen_rule: A new EvaluationRegistry over the same journal reads identical binding payloads and preserves idempotent exact begin/finish behavior.
strict_protocol_state_contract.mutation_rule: Binding or result failures happen before Journal.append; reuse of an existing result key with changed content is rejected by Journal idempotency and leaves all events unchanged.
strict_protocol_state_contract.legacy_rule: Legacy register/begin/finish with no scope, policy, admission, or cut continues to use an empty binding and its existing journal payload shape.

primary_scalar_identity_checks.policy: Exact frozen date, int64 nanosecond start, end rule, false pre-period flag, tuple of registered older scopes, and SHA-256 config hash.
primary_scalar_identity_checks.scope: Exact purpose text, nonempty string cohort/denominator IDs, and SHA-256 policy hash for primary.
primary_scalar_identity_checks.admission: Exact ResearchScopeV1 primary identity, SHA-256 population hash, and signed int64 actual_cut_at at or after the primary start.
primary_scalar_identity_checks.population: Complete retained population hash is checked at every primary fold, temporal fold, model, calibration, measurement, cohort, and protocol boundary.
primary_scalar_identity_checks.cut_upper_bounds: fit/evaluation/training clocks, sample decision/target/maturity/dependency clocks, dependency spans, and concrete cohort observation_end cannot exceed actual_cut_at; protocol endpoint planning is deliberately exempt.
primary_scalar_identity_checks.protocol_runtime: Protocol, report, started_at, finished_at, and model artifact key/value identities receive exact public-path checks.
